def current_system_state():
    import subprocess
    import sys
    import os

    # replace me — set this to the path of your sysinfo.py script
    script_path = r"C:\Path\To\Your\Project\skills\sysinfo\scripts\sysinfo.py"

    if os.path.exists(script_path):
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, script_path], capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8")
        print(result.stdout if result.stdout else "(no stdout)")
        print("\nSTDERR:")
        print(result.stderr if result.stderr else "(no stderr)")
        print("\nReturn code:", result.returncode)
    else:
        print("Script not found at:", script_path)
        # Let's check what's in the skills folder
        # replace me — set this to your skills directory
        skills_dir = r"C:\Path\To\Your\Project\skills"
        if os.path.exists(skills_dir):
            print("\nSkills directory contents:")
            for item in os.listdir(skills_dir):
                print(" -", item)
            sysinfo_dir = os.path.join(skills_dir, "sysinfo")
            if os.path.exists(sysinfo_dir):
                print("\nSysinfo skill contents:")
                for root, dirs, files in os.walk(sysinfo_dir):
                    level = root.replace(sysinfo_dir, '').count(os.sep)
                    indent = ' ' * 2 * level
                    print(f'{indent}{os.path.basename(root)}/')
                    subindent = ' ' * 2 * (level + 1)
                    for file in files:
                        print(f'{subindent}{file}')

def read_latest_email():
    import json
    import re
    from pathlib import Path

    # replace me — map your account addresses to friendly display labels
    _ACCOUNT_LABELS = {
        "your_primary_email@example.com":   "Found at Primary Inbox",
        "your_secondary_email@example.com": "Found at Secondary Inbox",
    }

    # replace me — your own email address (for special self-email handling)
    MY_EMAIL  = "you@example.com"
    # replace me — a trusted contact's email (e.g. a family member), or remove this block if unused
    MOM_EMAIL = "trusted_contact@example.com"

    def extract_email(raw_from: str) -> str:
        """Pull bare address out of strings like 'Name <addr@x.com>' or 'addr@x.com'."""
        match = re.search(r"<([^>]+)>", raw_from)
        return (match.group(1) if match else raw_from).strip().lower()

    def is_automated(raw_from: str, subject: str) -> bool:
        """Heuristic: noreply / mailer-daemon addresses or common auto-subject prefixes."""
        noreply_hints = ("noreply", "no-reply", "mailer-daemon", "donotreply",
                         "notifications", "automated", "bounce", "postmaster")
        combined = (raw_from + subject).lower()
        return any(hint in combined for hint in noreply_hints)

    temp_file = Path.home() / "email_trigger_latest.json"
    if not temp_file.exists():
        return None

    try:
        emails = json.loads(temp_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        return None

    for mail in emails:
        mail["account_label"] = _ACCOUNT_LABELS.get(
            mail.get("account"), mail.get("account")
        )

        raw_from  = mail.get("from", "")
        subject   = mail.get("subject", "")
        body      = mail.get("body", "").strip()
        sender    = extract_email(raw_from)

        # ── Print the standard header for every mail ──────────────────────────
        print(f"[{mail['account_label']}] From: {raw_from}")
        print(f"  Subject : {subject}")
        print(f"  Sent    : {mail.get('time_sent', 'Unknown')}")
        print(f"  Body    : {body}")
        print()

        # ── Case 1 · Self-sent email ───────────────────────────────────────────
        if sender == MY_EMAIL:
            print(
                "[AGENT DIRECTIVE]\n"
                f"An email was sent to you by the user ({MY_EMAIL}).\n"
                "Use your e-mailman skill and reply, fulfilling the request in WORK MODE."
                " Reply immediately after fulfilling the request!\n"
            )

        # ── Case 2 · Trusted contact ──────────────────────────────────────────
        elif sender == MOM_EMAIL:
            print(
                "[AGENT DIRECTIVE]\n"
                f"An email was sent to you by a trusted contact ({MOM_EMAIL}).\n"
                "Always reply to them warmly and respectfully.\n"
                "• Simple request  → Fulfill it, then reply back to confirm.\n"
                "• Complex request → Do NOT take immediate action. "
                "Send a polite reply letting them know you will inform the user. "
                "Then post a notification in the main channel so the user is aware "
                "of what they sent. And send the user an email."
                "📢 ACTION REQUIRED: Forward a summary of their message to the main "
                "channel now so the user is notified. Send the user an email too!\n"
            )

        # ── Case 3 · Unknown sender ───────────────────────────────────────────
        else:
            if is_automated(raw_from, subject):
                # Automated / mailer — note only, no reply
                sender_label = raw_from if raw_from else "Unknown Mailer"
                print(
                    f'📬 [Email Received from "{sender_label}"]\n'
                    "   This appears to be an automated message. No reply will be sent. But "
                    "send a message to main and send an email to the user regarding this."
                )
            else:
                # Real but unrecognised person
                print(
                    "[AGENT DIRECTIVE]\n"
                    f"An email was sent to you from an unrecognised address: {raw_from}\n"
                    "Use your best judgement. Do not take sensitive actions. "
                    "You may acknowledge the email if appropriate.\n"
                    "And send a message to main and send an email to the user regarding this."
                )
